decisions.reason: This position covers site setup, temporary equipment, logistics, and site clearance. It does not procure new components.
The deliverable is a piping and instrumentation diagram, not the equipment depicted in it.
The deliverable is a wall-mounted process diagram. The plastic backing or frame and hangers are included presentation accessories.
This position covers schedules, drawings, and field measurements. It does not procure the equipment shown in the drawings.
